title: Receipt Oracle — expense fortune teller
constraints: no external fonts — system fonts only

workerResult.summary: Receipt Oracle — a steampunk expense fortune teller. A brass Ledger Desk (add/edit via form, delete, burn-all, receipt stamp animation, localStorage persistence) feeds a scroll-reactive divination stage: a 400vh scroll journey pins a sticky brass viewport holding the Oracle eye (dilates with scroll), engraved opening line, category ledger bars, item-quoting omens, and Peril/Heat/Diligence needle dials — all driven by rAF-throttled window scroll progress with ink-reveal thresholds and prefers-reduced-motion fallback. Seeded deterministic reading reproduces on shared links; Copy Share-Link packs the ledger into a URL-safe token (?o=) that restores it (with replace-confirm), Export Poster downloads a self-contained HTML augury with inlined CSS, clipboard has execCommand fallback. System fonts only (no webfonts). Warm umber/brass/copper/parchment steampunk palette, engraved small-caps, rivet plates, gear emblem spin, gear-dust parallax, no indigo/gray/white defaults. base './' keeps dist assets relative. Build passes; verified via npm run build + npm run preview (all assets 200).
